recognize_zh: CD20 染色中，棕色陽性的小 B 淋巴球集中在上方與兩側的淋巴組織區，中央擴張竇內的大型組織球為陰性，僅有少量顆粒狀背景染色；顯示竇內的大細胞不是 B 細胞，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Clusters of small CD20-positive B lymphocytes in lymphoid areas at the upper and lateral edges
Central expanded sinus with CD20-negative large histiocytes
Fine granular background staining (likely debris or phagocytosed antigen) within the sinus
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 highlights small B lymphocytes clustered within the lymphoid compartments bordering an expanded sinus. The large sinus histiocytes are negative, with only faint granular background staining. No sheets of large CD20-positive cells are identified. Findings exclude a large B-cell lymphoma as the cause of the sinus expansion and support a histiocytic process, consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: DLBCL forms sheets of large atypical CD20-positive cells rather than CD20-negative histiocytes.
Monocytoid B cells expanding sinuses are CD20-positive with pale cytoplasm, unlike the CD20-negative histiocytes here.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30/CD15-positive with weak or absent CD20 and are not S100-positive histiocytes.
